title: Dream Mirror
text: A neutral creature of the Mirror Dream Border that wanders close to the ground. Holding a dream crystal attracts nearby Dream Mirrors.
Right-click its surface with a dream crystal to offer one crystal for a random reward. Rewards that do not fit in your inventory drop beside you.
Each offering has a 15% chance to yield Dream Crystal Budding Rock, 10% for a Primordial Spell Core, and 5% for an Arcane Crystal Grid. Place the budding rock to grow dream crystal clusters.
Other rewards include a shadow manuscript, a light crystal core, 16 spiritual crystals, or one earth, water, fire or air microcore.
Attacking the mirror does not seem like a particularly wise choice.
